role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
description: Sunak pledged in January 2023 to halve inflation during the year. The latest published rate was 10.7% for November 2022, below the October peak of 11.1%. CPI reached 4.6% in October 2023.
evidence: The government announced fulfillment on November 15, 2023 after October inflation fell to 4.6%.

promise: GM planned at least 20 new all-electric models globally by 2023.
description: GM reiterated the global model-launch target in its June 12, 2018 sustainability announcement.
evidence: GM's dated announcement supports the target and global scope.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: a complete global model inventory, including China and joint ventures, was not established.

person: PGA Tour, PIF and DP World Tour
role: Parties to the golf framework agreement
promise: The parties targeted December 31, 2023 for a definitive agreement, with an extension permitted by agreement.
description: The parties announced their framework on June 6, 2023. They extended the December 31 negotiating target without completing a definitive agreement by that date.
evidence: Contemporary December 31 reporting describes the original framework, its extendable deadline and the extension.
Broken refers to the missed original target, not a finding that no agreement could ever follow.

promise: FOMC participants' June 2021 median projection was a 0.6% federal-funds rate at end-2023 (forecast, not a promise).
description: The June 2021 projections showed a 0.6% median policy rate for end-2023. They were conditional individual assessments of appropriate monetary policy, not a commitment to keep rates near zero until 2024.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the retrieved projection table establishes the conditional forecast but not a reconciled end-2023 comparison; the original rate-rise arithmetic was not verified.

person: OECD Inclusive Framework on BEPS (Pillar Two)
role: OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework (136 jurisdictions at the October 2021 agreement)
promise: Envisage 2023 commencement of Pillar Two's 15% minimum-tax framework, with UTPR following in 2024 and adoption under a common approach
description: The October 8, 2021 agreement set a 15% minimum tax under Pillar Two. Jurisdictions were not obliged to adopt the GloBE rules, but agreed to apply them consistently if adopted. Its implementation plan envisaged 2023 commencement, with the undertaxed payments rule following in 2024.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the agreement and planned schedule are supported, but country-by-country enactment and commencement were not reconciled.

promise: Expect Neuralink's first human implantation later in 2023
description: At VivaTech on June 16, 2023, Musk said Neuralink hoped to perform its first human implantation later that year, following FDA clearance the previous month. The first implant was performed on January 28, 2024, according to his January 29 announcement.
evidence: First human implantation took place January 28, 2024, after the 2023 forecast window.

promise: Target a private crewed circumlunar dearMoon mission in 2023
description: SpaceX presented the dearMoon passenger on September 18, 2018 UTC. The project used a 2023 target and was later cancelled by its customer.
evidence: The mission did not fly in its target year and was cancelled in June 2024.
